verdict.rationale: Snyk Open Source documents scanning projects for license compliance against licenses known to Snyk, and finding and addressing licensing issues in dependencies, so license detection is a first-party capability. Enforcing a configurable license policy (allow/deny rules, severity, failing scans) is not explicitly documented; 'Policy management' appears only as a bare plan feature with no tie to licenses. Missing for 10: documented configurable license policy rules, evidence of scans or CI failing on license violations, license reporting depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can detect the licenses of my dependencies and enforce a license policy in scans

citations.quote: Snyk Open Source can also scan your Projects for license compliance, checking against licenses known to Snyk.
You can also find and address licensing issues in or caused by these open-source libraries.
